app_info.subtitle: Search Guard security receipts
app_info.description: HOL Guard lets users search and fetch their Guard security receipts, artifact inventory, and workspace status through ChatGPT. All tools are read-only — no mutation, approval, or admin operations are exposed.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves matching receipts and inventory items from the authenticated user's synced Guard workspace without creating or updating records.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems; operates solely within the user's private Guard workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves a single receipt or inventory item by opaque ID from the authenticated user's synced Guard workspace without modifying any data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems; operates solely within the user's private Guard workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only reports workspace status metadata such as data availability and freshness without accessing or modifying receipt data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or third-party systems; operates solely within the user's private Guard workspace.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, or perform irreversible actions.

test_cases.description: User asks to search their Guard receipts for a specific term.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my Guard receipts for AIBOM scans
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a list of sanitized receipt summaries matching the query, each with an opaque ID, artifact name, and policy decision. Results are capped at 20.

test_cases.description: User asks for their current Guard workspace status.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns workspace status including data availability, receipt count, and last sync freshness indicator.

test_cases.description: User asks to fetch a specific receipt by its opaque ID after finding it in search results.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the full sanitized receipt text, capped at 32 KiB, with artifact metadata and policy decision details.

test_cases.description: User searches with a broad query to see all available receipts.
test_cases.user_prompt: Search my Guard receipts for everything
test_cases.expected_output: Returns up to 20 sanitized receipt summaries. Each result includes an opaque namespaced ID for use with the fetch tool.

test_cases.description: User asks to check if their Guard data is up to date.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns status with freshness indicator showing whether data is real-time or stale.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for general security questions unrelated to Guard receipts.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How do I secure my AWS account?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is about general security advice, not Guard receipt data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to approve or resolve Guard findings.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because v1 exposes only read-only tools and cannot approve, deny, or resolve findings.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for requests to sync or upload data to Guard.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Sync my local Guard data to the cloud
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because v1 exposes only read-only tools and cannot sync, upload, or modify data.
